newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at Brazil's Santos port.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at Brazil's Santos port.

text.p: Santos port reported the following conditions for shipments of soybeans and soymeal:
Vessels: Ziemia Krakowska loading 19,000 tonnes soymeal. Flag Nikolas was loading soybeans at private Cargill terminal.
Road: 196 trucks arrived Tuesday of which 168 were carrying soybeans and 10 soymeal (the rest was citrus meal). A total of 4,981 tonnes of product was unloaded.
Rail: 29 wagons arrived Tuesday, unloading 1,241 tonnes soymeal.
